newsitem.title: BELGIUM: "BEYAERT" 100 FRANC BILL WORTHLESS FROM DEC 16.
newsitem.headline: "BEYAERT" 100 FRANC BILL WORTHLESS FROM DEC 16.

text.p: The Belgian 100 franc bill bearing a picture of Hendrik Beyaert which has been draining from circulation since September 2 will have no street value from December 16, the Belgian National Bank said on Tuesday.
"The bills in question will cease to be legal tender and wil only be exchangeable at the counters of the National Bank of Belgium," the bank said in a statement.
